content.title: 限制性定语从句·关系词速查(who/whom/which/that·whose·where/when/why)
content.intro: 先看先行词指人还是指物,再看从句缺什么成分。缺主语/宾语→用关系代词(who/whom/which/that);不缺主宾、只缺状语→用关系副词(where/when/why)或「介词+which/whom」;表所属→whose。

rows: 指人、从句缺主语:the guide who knows the city
指人、从句缺宾语或介词后:the man whom we met / to whom I spoke
指物、从句缺主宾:the temple which/that was moved
表所属(谁的):the writer whose book won a prize
从句缺地点/时间/原因状语:the place where… / the day when… / the reason why…
从句不缺主宾、更正式:in which / by which / to whom

specialRules.rule: 从句缺主语/宾语 → 关系代词(who/whom/which/that)
specialRules.mark: the relics that we saved(缺宾语→that)

specialRules.rule: 从句不缺主宾、只缺状语 → 关系副词或介词+which
介词后只能用 which 或 whom,不可用 that
whose = 谁的,引导表所属的从句
specialRules.mark: the engineer whose team moved the temples

why: 关系副词(where/when/why)= 介词+which,在从句里作状语,所以主语、宾语都齐;一旦从句缺了主语或宾语,就必须换成关系代词 who/whom/which/that。
gaokaoPoints: 判断口诀:先行词指人/指物 + 从句缺主宾还是缺状语;语法填空高频。
易错:先行词是地点/时间但从句缺宾语时,用 that/which 而非 where/when(the place that I visited)。
介词提前时,指物用 which、指人用 whom(in which / to whom),不用 that。

examVsReal.exam: the door through which you can leave（考试/书面）
examVsReal.real: the door you can leave through
examVsReal.note: 口语常省略关系词、把介词放句末

examVsReal.exam: the man to whom I spoke（正式）
examVsReal.real: the man I spoke to / the man who I spoke to
examVsReal.note: 口语里常省略 whom 或用 who,介词移到句末
